{{Quote|If we know anything about the Sith, it's that they're always at each other's throats.|[[Jiyan Dar]]|<ref name="AGA">{{TORcite|type=general|A Gentleman's Agreement|Ilum}}</ref>}}
The '''Sith Order''' of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] was an organization made up of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals that lived within the borders of the Empire. Members of this incarnation of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were housed and trained in [[Sith academy|academies]] on two Imperial controlled worlds named [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], with the latter also housing its headquarters in the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel's]] [[Sith Sanctum]] as well as lesser academies on worlds such as [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Odacer-Faustin]]. They were governed by a group of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] called the [[Dark Council]], who controlled every move and every action that the Sith Order and the Sith Empire alike would take.
